t: This Collingwood 20W outdoor LED floodlight provides powerful and adjustable illumination for various exterior applications. Featuring a robust cast aluminium body with salt mist protective paint and stainless steel fixings, it is ideal for coastal areas and general outdoor security lighting. The integrated PIR sensor offers reliable motion detection with a 300° angle and 10m range, while the flicker-free, colour-switchable LED (3000/4000/6500K) delivers versatile lighting. Installation is straightforward with a first mount, detachable circular bracket, and the unit offers 360° rotation and 180° tilt for precise light direction. Supplied in card/paper packaging suitable for kerbside recycling.
